_source: Inside Decoded Short, Palm Beach Learjet crash, 1.9M views, 80 s. Built-in browser 2026-11-20: frames at 0, 3, 14, 34, 56, 70, 78.5 s. SAMPLED. Our own descriptions.

hook.firstFrame: a white 3D jet banked steeply over a storm-cloud deck; title block top-left with the crash name and registration/route/date in small mono; '3D RECONSTRUCTION' top-right
hook.firstLine: In about a minute, a jet fell more than 26,000 feet.

shots.picture: steeply banked 3D jet over storm cloud, title block and reconstruction tag
same dive, the figure slams in at the top
level flight above cloud, telemetry panel top-left: clock, altitude, rate, data source
the jet starting to roll; the panel flags the clock as paused while a cause is explained; red falling rate; 'an illustration' tag
nose-down jet in cloud; the panel flags 'speed up 2x'
grey blurred ground rushing up; the toll in white caps
the whole path as a colour-graded curtain (blue to orange to red) over satellite terrain

ending.cta: points to the clearest view of the path (the full reconstruction)

whyItWorks: A telemetry panel (clock, altitude, falling rate, source) turns the Short into a live readout.
Honest time controls on screen: 'time paused' while explaining, 'speed up 2x' through the dive.
The end figure (26,000 ft in a minute) is in the first 3 s; the toll waits for the ground.
